This is getting railroaded way too fast. Frank’s “logic” depends on everyone accepting his route as fact, but he’s the least cleared person here.

I did see Eve in weapons around tick 5, yes — but I left north through cafeteria/medbay/upper engine. I did not stay with her. Nobody actually knows when Eve died, only when Diana found her.

For Bob: I saw him alive in medbay around tick 9/10 after he left electrical. That actually lines up with Frank being right behind him from electrical. Frank says he went to security and saw Diana at 12, but electrical → medbay → security is completely possible in that window. He could have followed Bob, killed him, then gone security and used Diana as a soft alibi.

Also, Frank is “clearing” Diana and Diana is accepting it, but that doesn’t clear Frank. He was with Bob immediately before Bob died, and now he’s pushing me because I gave honest sightings. That feels like he’s using my info to build a case.

If you vote me here, geese lose. Frank has the tighter timing on Bob, and we don’t actually have a hard time of death on Eve. I’m voting Frank.
